Select molecule ChEMBL ID, molecule name, max phase, molecule type, and canonical SMILES for compounds reported in the specified document. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id, filtering by document ChEMBL ID. Left join compound_structures on molregno to retrieve canonical SMILES. Return all columns as specified, allowing null SMILES when structures are missing. Sort by molecule ChEMBL ID.
